newsitem.title: GERMANY: VEW - 4-mo gp pretax profit 196 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: VEW - 4-mo gp pretax profit 196 mln dmk.

text.p: German energy group VEW AG said on Thursday that it had raised pretax profit in the first four months of 1997 by 3.3 percent to 196 million marks, depsite lower turnover in the period.

The group said at its annual shareholder meeting that energy production was down in the January to April period because the weather had been mild and sales fell 1.8 percent to 30.2 billion marks in the period.
Electricity sales fell 7.4 percent to 14.567 billion kilowatt hours, while gas production fell 13.6 percent to 17.39 billion kilowatt hours.
